report:
RTA NEWS ROUND 5 (researched 2026-11-01). Task: route information from Regional Transport Authority decisions as reported in newspapers, digital media and websites.

RESULT: 8 systems, 85 routes (all coordinates null; pipeline to geocode).
- karachi-drta-notices-2002 (NEW, status historical): 25 routes with full ordered stops from 12 Dawn articles (2002-01 to 2003-11) that print DRTA/RTA Karachi decisions verbatim: new routes 1-L, 17-L, Z-7, Z-25, 15-E, 2-B, New Kashmir Coach, Jamal Coach, two unnumbered DRTA Board routes (Gulshan-e-Bihar - Ayub Goth; Jail Chowrangi - Qadhafi Town), Surjani - Tower trial route, Green Bus CNG Jauhar - Tower and Green Bus express Landhi - Surjani; plus 2002-03 alignments of ids we hold (B-3, 1-C, Y, F-6, 4, S-2, 10-A, 5, G-27, P-6, W-25, Super Muslim Coach). Overlap with held routes is in each note; only S-2 is clearly the same route as today's. Historical: never use in the planner.
- Abbottabad (append, 17 routes): RTA Hazara Suzuki pick-up fare notice of 2026-07-10 (APP) names 20 local fare stages from the General Suzuki Stand and Nawan Shehr; plus 2 Qalandarabad routes (APP 2026-06-03). Mostly 2-stop; Mandian, Nawan Shehr, Kakul and Bani-Complex have intermediate stages. Fares in notes.
- RTA Peshawar fare table 2024-04-01, serials 77-111 transcribed from the official scans (pages 03-04 on transport.kp.gov.pk): charsadda-private-wagons (NEW, 13 incl. Ghalanai - Shabqadar), nowshera-private-wagons (NEW, 7), khyber-private-wagons (NEW, 6), and 9 appended to peshawar-private-wagons (Jamrud, Landi Kotal, Torkham, Mohmand routes). Terminals only, km and 4 fare classes. New city ids charsadda/nowshera/khyber need cities.json entries (or attach to peshawar). Serials 55-76 are intercity (Malakand, Swabi, Kohat/Bannu) and were not added.
- Rawalpindi: 2 RTA-approved AC bus routes to Islamabad International Airport (2020, stop lists; no evidence they ran) and 1 historical ITA route Margalla Town - F-11 (2003); 5 RTA-allocated e-bus routes (Dawn 2025-09-27) not matching any route in data, added as planned.

EVIDENCE (36 items): Arab News 2025-12-03 confirms W-11 North Karachi - Keamari still running (about 120 buses); Zameen blog 2023-02-23 gives terminals for 15 current minibus/coach routes (D-10, F-16, S-2, W-18, X-8, X-10, W-22, F-11, G-25, Gulistan Coach, Safari, Data, Super Hasanzai, N-4, W-11); several conflict with our terminals (W-18, X-10, F-11, Super Hasanzai) - flagged, not changed. Dawn 2001-03 notes corroborate 16, F-5, C-1, 4-B, 4-D, 17-H/J/K, G-5; Dawn 2002 gives P-1 and N-4 extensions. Rawalpindi RTA e-bus routes 2/4/5 match RWP-EB-02..04. No replace_existing proposed: no 2023-26 article gives a fuller stop list than ours for any held route.

RTA DECISIONS (37): Karachi 2001-2005 DRTA notices (above), coach numbering 2005 (zones 100-899, names to numbers; no alignments), minibus permit ban lifted Dec 2020, Tribune Dec 2022 (Transport Dept data: buses 16/60, minibuses 42/234, coaches 20/70 routes operating), RTA Board 2026-08-06; Rawalpindi airport routes 2020, e-bus route allocation 2025, fare rise 2026-04; RTA Peshawar fare notices 2024 and 2026-08-12; RTA Hazara 2026 fares and colour stickers; Gujranwala 2004, Lahore 2002, Multan 2001 wagon decisions.

WHAT DID NOT WORK / NOT FOUND: No 2023-2026 newspaper article lists the stops of any Karachi private minibus/coach route; modern Karachi RTA coverage is policy-level only (2026-08 Board meeting). Searches for route numbers W-11, G-7, X-10, N-4, Z-2, D-11, U-6, 4-K, X-5, F-11, 2-K, 5-C, 9-C, 1-D, A-25, W-25, Y-11 returned only the items above. No RTA Lahore wagon route list, no RTA Rawalpindi Suzuki/wagon permit list, no RTA Peshawar intra-city wagon list in the press. Urdu searches (روٹ پرمٹ، آر ٹی اے کراچی روٹ، منی بس روٹ نمبر) found only PBS news and a Jang memoir. Reddit/r/karachi is not fetchable; Jang, Tribune and The News return 403 directly (Tribune and Jang read as stripped text via web.archive.org id_ with curl; nothing saved). Dawn's 2002-2003 archive is rich, but search engines surface only about 15 such notices; a day-by-day scan of dawn.com/newspaper/karachi/YYYY-MM-DD for 2000-2008 (headlines containing 'route') would likely find many more DRTA notices - not done (would take about 3,000 page fetches). Punjab Assembly answer 2010-02-17 lists Lahore urban bus companies (28 routes) without route names. Multan.pdf on transport.punjab.gov.pk is a bus-stand list, not routes.

SAFETY: Archived pages were read only as stripped text piped through a local script (scripts removed, nothing saved). Downloaded only 3 official JPEG scans from transport.kp.gov.pk and 2 government PDFs (auto-saved by the fetch tool), all in temp folders outside the project. No .htm/.js/.exe/macro files saved; data/systems not edited; nothing deleted.

rta_decisions.decision: Permit violations reported on routes 16, F-5, C-1, C-2; Quaidabad - Port Bin Qasim bus route permitted 6 buses (17 running).
Created/extended/amended bus 1-L, 17-L, 1-C, minibus B-3, Z-7, Z-25 and New Kashmir Coach (stop lists in karachi-drta-notices-2002).
New 15-E Express bus route Malir-Khokhrapar - Shershah/Gulbai approved; fares Rs 5/7/10.
18 Urban Transport Scheme routes offered to bidders (22 firms interested; min. 25 new buses per route). Route list with via points in the article.
Amended minibus Y, F-6 and Super Muslim Coach (Keamari leg curtailed; extended Tower - Gulbai/New Mauripur).
Amended bus route 4 (New Sabzi Mandi - Tower); approved new minibus S-2 Korangi 100 Quarters - Ayub Goth.
Route-permit procedure to be simplified; committee to allocate new routes; 15 CNG bus companies to get one-window registration.
18 UTS routes classified with the RTA, depots to be allotted (Surjani-Dockyard, Surjani-Korangi, Khokhrapar-Orangi, Baldia-Keamari, etc.).
4 Green Bus CNG buses granted Gulistan-e-Jauhar - Tower; minibus P-1 extended to Hawksbay; N-4 extended Qayyumabad - Bilal Colony via Korangi Industrial Area; P-6 realigned.
New bus route 10-A Sindbad (Clifton) - Abidabad; minibus route 5 amended (Gulshan-e-Bihar - Khokhrapar).
New minibus route G-27 (lede says G-29) Orangi - Airport allowed for 6 months; P-6 realigned Khokhrapar - Naval Colony.
Unpermitted buses/minibuses to be fined and impounded after one week; Surjani Town - Tower route approved for a private company (one-month trial).
Route permits cancelled for some operators; token system debated (no route lists).
Route 2B Tower - North Karachi allotted to 10 new diesel buses (38 planned); buses allowed on Zaibunnisa Street and Abdullah Haroon Road.
New bus routes Gulshan-e-Bihar - Ayub Goth and PIB Colony/Jail Chowrangi - Qadhafi Town; minibus W-25 amended; ban on new minibus permits kept.
Jamal Coach route amended (Surjani 5-D - Islam Nagar via Clifton, Keamari).
Green Bus express Landhi - Surjani Town to start 2003-11-11.

Coach names abolished; coaches allotted 3-digit route numbers by zone (Zone I 100-199 Baldia/Orangi ... Zone VIII 800-899 Hawkesbay/Mauripur), e.g. Bilal 102, Ilyas 105, Khan 203, Safari 407, Muslim 501, Shiraz 502, Marwat 604, Mashriq 605. No alignments given.
Ban on 26-seat minibus route permits lifted after 25 years (Samaa Dec 2020; Business Recorder).

Context: 75 CNG buses bought in 2009 ran three official routes (Surjani-Tower, Surjani-Korangi, Orangi-Malir) until 2011; 36 repaired buses later ran Gulshan-e-Hadeed - Tower. All closed. (Express Tribune, read via Wayback text; exact date approximate, Dec 2020.)
About 380 routes closed over 14 years; only 80 operating: big buses 16 of 60, minibuses 42 of 234, coaches 20 of 70 (Express Tribune, via Wayback text).
Double-decker routes approved; service Malir - Shahrah-e-Faisal from 2026-01-01, extended Malir Halt - Tower 2026-02-16.
Bus route policy to be rationalised by demand; priority permits for suburbs; discourage long intra-city routes; rickshaw digital meters (already known from round 4).
Classified route Seth Kamaluddin School (Fakir-ka-Pir) - Latifabad No. 11 via Latifabad No. 10 for vehicle/minibus permits.
Margalla Town - F-11 Service Road route approved (added, historical); Tarnol - Pak Secretariat to be surveyed first; pre-1998 vehicles banned within 3 months.
Approved AC bus routes Rawat - IIA, Koral Chowk - IIA (Rs 270) and Rawat - Taxila; 2020-03-02 district administration/RDTB invited permit applications (stop lists added; Rawat - Taxila has no stops).

Allocated 10 routes for 80 e-buses: Railway Station-LHC Bench, Koral-Fawara, Umar Baig Chowk-Mandi Mor, Munawar Colony-Saddar, Marrir-Motorway Mor, Faizabad-Tramri, IJP Metro-Kuri Road, Saddar-Lalarukh Colony, Umair Baig Road-Qadeemi Imambargah, and one via Saddar.
Agreed in principle to raise private transport fares 25-37% (local non-AC 25%, local AC 30%); Punjab government rejected the 37% proposal (Dawn 1989283).
Considering re-issuing route permits; only big new buses on routes touching Khyber Bazaar/Saddar; Landi Kotal/Jamrud/Bara buses to stop at Ring Road.
Diesel fare table No. 286-310/RTA/PESH for 111 routes (serials 1-54 already merged; 77-111 added in this file; 55-76 are intercity, not added).
Revised passenger fares notified for Peshawar routes after diesel price rises (no route list in the press report).
Official fares enforced on Qalandarabad routes (Bandi Dhundan, Meera Bin Rs 30) after drivers' protest.
Colour-coded route stickers for local Suzuki pick-ups launched (no colour-to-route list published).
Revised Suzuki pick-up fares for 20 local routes/stages from Abbottabad General Suzuki Stand and Nawan Shehr (added as routes).
480 wagon route permits cancelled for a franchised city bus service; wagons barred from GT Road.
Wagon route 7 Rang Mahal - Baker Mandi cancelled in 1999 but still plied; route 21 Sabzazar - Jallo Mor curtailed to Daroghawala Chowk; ~50% of vans without permits.
Franchised bus service on 7 routes (first: Dera Adda - General Bus Stand); poor-condition wagons' permits to be cancelled.
